label: Protect from fire
does_not_apply_when: Never overridden by later rules; insects/fuel-add do not change this action
threshold_notes: Binary EVT flag not a percentile
example: Managed pine plantation (even with insect fuel-add) → protect

label: Wetlands - assess locally
example: Large acidic fen/peat majority → wetlands assess

label: Treat fire risk for people
required_conditions: High WFE + high WRTC Housing Unit Risk; not plantation/peat
fdist_role: Not required for trigger; FDist may still raise SCORE_PEOPLE
does_not_apply_when: Skipped if plantation or peat already matched
threshold_notes: High WFE: WFE_CAT in High/Very High OR MEAN >= 70th percentile (top 30%). High people: WRTC_HU_RISK_MEAN >= 70th percentile (top 30%)
example: Hot jack pine next to lake homes → treat for people

label: Ecosystem health focus
trigger_summary: High WFE AND NOT high people
required_conditions: High WFE + not-high people; not plantation/peat
fdist_role: Not required for trigger; may raise score
does_not_apply_when: Skipped if plantation/peat or step 3 matched
example: Hot continuous pine far from housing → ecosystem

label: Treat fire risk for people
trigger_summary: High fuel-add AND high people (WFE not already high)
required_conditions: FDIST_FUEL_DELTA >= fdist_fuel_add_min (default 0.25) AND high people; WFE not high; not plantation/peat
fdist_role: **Primary FDist→people path** — recent fuel add near homes when WFE is soft
does_not_apply_when: Skipped if plantation/peat/high-WFE steps already matched
threshold_notes: FDIST_FUEL_DELTA = hex mean of pixel FUEL_DIRECTION_1 (-1 remove / 0 neutral / +1 add) from other_outputs/LF2024_FDist.csv. High fuel-add sets FDIST_FUEL_ADD=1
example: Low WFE + ice storm / insect mortality near homes → treat for people

label: Ecosystem health focus
trigger_summary: High fuel-add AND NOT high people (WFE not already high)
required_conditions: FDIST_FUEL_DELTA >= 0.25 AND not-high people; WFE not high; not plantation/peat

label: Ecosystem health focus
trigger_summary: Pine/barrens EVT list (any people/WFE if not caught above)
required_conditions: EVT_MAJORITY in config/evt_pine_barrens.csv; not plantation/peat; not already high-WFE or high-fuel-add path
fdist_role: Not required — pine acts even if FDist ~0
does_not_apply_when: If high WFE or high fuel-add already assigned people/ecosystem above those win first; pine alone still catches remaining pine hexes
threshold_notes: 12 EVT codes (jack/red pine forests barrens oak barrens etc.). Review if pine-hemlock 7366 too broad
example: Red pine majority low WFE quiet FDist → ecosystem

label: Defer / monitor
required_conditions: Not plantation; not peat; not high WFE; not high fuel-add; not pine/barrens list
fdist_role: Fuel-add below 0.25 does not trigger action (may still slightly affect score if delta>0)
example: Northern hardwoods low WFE FDist 0.1 → defer

label: PAD context (GAP 1-3 frac)
trigger_summary: Map/Leaflet context only — NOT an action trigger and NOT in SCORE_PEOPLE
threshold_notes: Shown as separate Leaflet layer / popup
example: National forest hex with high PAD frac still follows WFE/people/pine rules for action

label: EVT fire flag (-1/0/1)
trigger_summary: Context/popup only — NOT an action trigger
required_conditions: Joined from other_outputs/evt_aoi_attributes.csv FIRE column on EVT_MAJORITY
does_not_apply_when: FIRE=-1 (developed) does NOT auto-protect; people come from WRTC. FIRE=1 alone does NOT assign ecosystem (must be on pine list or other rules)
threshold_notes: -1 bad if burned / developed; 0 not fire-dependent; 1 fire-dependent (includes many wetlands — do not use raw FIRE=1 for actions)
example: Developed EVT FIRE=-1 with high WRTC+WFE → treat for people via WRTC not via FIRE

label: BpS/MFRI fire-dependent
trigger_summary: Context/validation only — NOT an action trigger
threshold_notes: Premise check in script 04 vs high WFE
example: Long-interval BpS under high WFE flagged in console only

label: Mild or negative fuel change
trigger_summary: No action from FDist alone if delta < 0.25
fdist_role: Values in (0 0.25) = mild add score bump only; negative = net fuel remove no action
does_not_apply_when: Does not by itself change ACTION_CLASS
threshold_notes: Pixel: insects/windthrow=+1; fire/mastication/mech remove/mech add(chipping)=-1; unknown/none=0
example: Recent prescribed fire (fuel remove) on hardwoods → still defer unless other triggers

label: Priority band 0-3
trigger_summary: Ranking among actionable hexes only — not a separate action
required_conditions: ACTION_CLASS not defer_monitor; ranked by SCORE_PEOPLE
fdist_role: Positive FDist fuel-add increases SCORE_PEOPLE via w_fuel_add so fuel-add hexes can enter top bands
example: High people + high WFE often priority 3

label: People-first score
required_conditions: w_homes*WRTC + w_plantations*plantation + w_wfe*WFE + w_fuel_add*max(0 FDIST_FUEL_DELTA); PAD weight=0
fdist_role: Fuel-add term uses only positive delta
does_not_apply_when: Does not assign ACTION_CLASS by itself
example: Quiet pine can be ecosystem but low score → Goldilocks 0
